evidence_precedence_guidance: Raw Git objects, diffs, tree state, and current executable source/workflows are stronger evidence of repository facts than generated narrative summaries.

Persisted nonce state/messages/store are primary evidence of what the Supervisor recorded during those runs, but model statements inside them remain testimony unless corroborated by repository/runtime evidence.
Agents.md and evaluation artifacts are evidence of specified or requested behavior; they do not alone prove executable enforcement.
commit-history.md is a secondary historical interpretation artifact and is known to contain semantic judgments that must not be treated as raw ground truth.

files.description: Fresh path-scoped chronological Git history with patches for agents_md: Current canonical Supervisor specification. Its present contents are evidence of today's stated requirements. Its Git history is generated into the archive to show how requested requirements and schemas changed over time. Specification text alone does not prove runtime enforcement.

Fresh path-scoped chronological Git history with patches for dependency_map: Standalone file-to-file dependency map consumed by the dependency synchronization workflow. Establishes which peer artifacts are expected to remain aligned when a mapped authoritative file changes.

Fresh path-scoped chronological Git history with patches for dependency_sync_workflow: Current maintenance workflow that synchronizes mapped Supervisor dependency files after Agents.md or runtime-source changes. It is part of the machine-maintenance architecture, not the normal user-request execution path.

Fresh path-scoped chronological Git history with patches for live_ground_truth_skill: Skill document defining live ground-truth verification concepts used during development. The current runtime contains deterministic ground-truth mechanisms, but this document itself is descriptive evidence rather than executable enforcement.

Fresh path-scoped chronological Git history with patches for runtime_source: Current Node.js Supervisor runtime. The current file is primary evidence of implemented validation, Gemini supervision, state transitions, persistence, and ground-truth checks. Its generated Git history is evidence of implementation changes over time.

Fresh path-scoped chronological Git history with patches for state_machine_workflow: Current GitHub Actions entrypoint for normal Supervisor execution. Establishes the actual repository event that starts the machine, Node runtime setup, environment, and which run-state changes are committed.

Fresh path-scoped chronological Git history with patches for step3_evaluation: Current consolidated Step 3 evaluation heuristic and Step3_TSR corpus. It is injected into Step 3 supervision by the current runtime. Its Git history helps identify changes in desired evaluation behavior and test coverage.

Fresh path-scoped chronological Git history with patches for supervisor_config: Current shared Supervisor path/dependency configuration consumed by the runtime. Its history can show when external artifacts and runtime surfaces became canonical.

Fresh path-scoped chronological Git history with patches for work_action_approval_rulebook: Persisted work/action approval rulebook produced during Supervisor development. Its existence proves the artifact was created; whether the current runtime actually enforces it must be decided from executable wiring, not from this file alone.
Fresh complete Git lineage for the Supervisor and predecessor paths at the workflow checkout, generated directly from Git with rename/copy detection.
Exact historical-audit source map used to construct this packet, including descriptions and authority guidance.
Exact trigger/request and archive selection used for this historical-audit run.

Current GitHub Actions entrypoint for normal Supervisor execution. Establishes the actual repository event that starts the machine, Node runtime setup, environment, and which run-state changes are committed.

Current maintenance workflow that synchronizes mapped Supervisor dependency files after Agents.md or runtime-source changes. It is part of the machine-maintenance architecture, not the normal user-request execution path.

Current canonical Supervisor specification. Its present contents are evidence of today's stated requirements. Its Git history is generated into the archive to show how requested requirements and schemas changed over time. Specification text alone does not prove runtime enforcement.

Generated commit-by-commit narrative for the Supervisor lineage. Useful for locating candidate initiating prompts, design movements, and prior semantic interpretations. Its SUCCESS/FAILURE judgments are not authoritative and were previously shown to over-infer semantics; corroborate claims with raw Git, nonce records, or verbatim user evidence.

Previously generated raw Git log snapshot for the GeminiSupervisor and predecessor lineage through its recorded cutoff. Useful as a fixed historical snapshot, but the workflow also generates a fresh live lineage log so later commits are not omitted.
Current shared Supervisor path/dependency configuration consumed by the runtime. Its history can show when external artifacts and runtime surfaces became canonical.
Standalone file-to-file dependency map consumed by the dependency synchronization workflow. Establishes which peer artifacts are expected to remain aligned when a mapped authoritative file changes.

Retired evaluation documents preserved after later architecture changes. These are historical evidence of earlier desired/evaluative structures and are useful for requirement lineage and supersession analysis, but they are not current governing requirements merely because they remain in the repository.
